en-US:
stashy 4.0, the biggest update so far:
• 17 languages with an in-app language picker
• For You and Forgotten Favorites (stashy+), built on your device
• Your own Home rows from a saved filter or a sort
• Sub-studios, sub-tags, sub-groups and containing groups
• Tags on performers, delete markers, assign scenes in Edit Gallery
• Pinch to zoom in the player
• Image scaling and background options
• Optional local address per server
• Faster Home and lists, many bug fixes
